import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots showing different aspects of the iris dataset
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Color palette for species
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#95E1D3'}

# 1. Scatter plot: Petal length vs Petal width (most discriminative features)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Species', loc='upper left', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Scatter plot: Sepal length vs Sepal width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, color=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Species', loc='upper right', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Box plots for all measurements
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
measurement_cols = ['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width']
data_for_box = []
labels_for_box = []
positions = []
pos = 0

for i, col in enumerate(measurement_cols):
    for j, species in enumerate(sorted(df['species'].unique())):
        species_data = df[df['species'] == species][col]
        data_for_box.append(species_data)
        if i == 0:
            labels_for_box.append(species[:3].capitalize())
        else:
            labels_for_box.append('')
        positions.append(pos)
        pos += 1
    pos += 0.5

bp = ax3.boxplot(data_for_box, positions=positions, widths=0.6, patch_artist=True,
                  labels=labels_for_box, showfliers=False)

# Color the boxes
species_list = sorted(df['species'].unique())
for i, patch in enumerate(bp['boxes']):
    species_idx = i % 3
    patch.set_facecolor(colors[species_list[species_idx]])
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)

ax3.set_ylabel('Measurement (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Measurements by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.set_xticks([1, 4.5, 8, 11.5])
ax3.set_xticklabels(['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'], fontsize=10)
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# 4. Violin plot comparing petal length across species
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
species_order = sorted(df['species'].unique())
parts = ax4.violinplot([df[df['species'] == s]['petal_length'].values for s in species_order],
                        positions=range(len(species_order)), widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)

for i, pc in enumerate(parts['bodies']):
    pc.set_facecolor(colors[species_order[i]])
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
    pc.set_edgecolor('black')
    pc.set_linewidth(1.5)

ax4.set_xticks(range(len(species_order)))
ax4.set_xticklabels([s.capitalize() for s in species_order], fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Analysis of Flower Measurements', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
